clinical_course: Presented with 18h RIF pain, fever 38.2C, raised WBC. USG c/w acute appendicitis. Underwent uncomplicated lap appy on 21/09. POD1 tolerating PO, ambulating. Afebrile, wounds clean and dry. D/C POD2.
follow_up: Surgical OPD review in 7 days for wound check. Port-site sutures are absorbable; no removal needed.
warning_signs: Fever above 38C, increasing abdominal pain, redness or discharge from wounds, persistent vomiting, not passing urine.
activity_and_diet: Normal diet as tolerated. Walk daily. No heavy lifting (>5 kg) for 2 weeks. May shower after 48 hours.

medications.name: paracetamol
medications.frequency: every 6 hours as needed for pain, maximum 4 doses in 24 hours

medications.name: amoxicillin-clavulanate
medications.frequency: three times a day after food
